vendor/mediabunny-aac.js is @mediabunny/aac-encoder 1.61.0 (MPL-2.0, see
mediabunny-aac-encoder-MPL-2.0.txt). It contains a WebAssembly build of
FFmpeg's native AAC encoder. FFmpeg is licensed under the GNU Lesser General
Public License version 2.1 or later (LGPL-2.1+): https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/main/packages/aac-encoder
It is only loaded when the browser has no AAC encoder of its own (e.g. Firefox).
